identity.notes: 108 mixed-chemistry cylindrical cells; calendar-ageing capacity tables for five chemistries (LCO, LFP, LMO, LTO, NCA) at three SOC and 50/60 °C; no waveforms; Geisbauer et al. Energies 2021

cell.chemistry_label_raw: LCO; LFP; LMO; LTO; NCA; NMC

conditions.protocol_charge_raw: initial capacity test: 1C CC-CV charge to the upper cut-off with a C/50 end current; OCV at C/20 after a C/50 CCCV charge; storage in climate chambers at 50 and 60 C (and a laboratory cabinet at 18.5 C) open circuit at three storage voltages UL, UM and UH per chemistry, with check-ups at regular intervals
conditions.protocol_discharge_raw: 1C CC discharge to the lower cut-off after a 30 min rest (capacity); 1C 10 s pulse at the mid voltage for the DC resistance; C/20 discharge for the OCV; AC impedance at 1 kHz

content.cycle_basis: one row per check-up (RPT) day; n_cycles counts check-ups, not cycles
content.count_basis: 108 distinct (chemistry, Cell Identity Number) keys across six CSV tables, alternate formats counted once; calendar check-ups are not aging cycles.

quality.notes: Author capacity tables (Discharge/Charge Capacity per check-up day) for cells stored at three SOC and 50/60 C; no waveforms. The zip repeats every table as csv, xlsx and txt; only the csv is read. Five chemistries (LCO/LFP/LMO/LTO/NCA) are tested with no manufacturer or model name disclosed for any of them. nominal_capacity_Ah, voltage_min_V/voltage_max_V and dimensions_mm are left null for all - not identifiable from a public datasheet, and would differ per chemistry regardless.

Author capacity tables (Discharge/Charge Capacity per check-up day) for cells stored at three SOC and 50/60 C; no waveforms. The zip repeats every table as csv, xlsx and txt; only the csv is read. Five chemistries (LCO/LFP/LMO/LTO/NCA) are tested with no manufacturer or model name disclosed for any of them. nominal_capacity_Ah, voltage_min_V/voltage_max_V and dimensions_mm are left null for all - not identifiable from a public datasheet, and would differ per chemistry regardless. Charging profile: null: calendar-ageing study; no charge protocol in the raw files, and none stated by the source. The data article (Geisbauer et al., Energies 14 (2021) 3358; full text read) states: six commercially available cylindrical cell types of 1.3 to 2.6 Ah (nominal capacities from the data sheets, cut-offs UMax/UMin): Samsung NCA 2500 mAh 4.20/2.50 V, Samsung NMC 2600 mAh 4.20/2.75 V, Heter LFP 1600 mAh 3.65/2.50 V, Panasonic LCO 2600 mAh 4.20/2.75 V, Nitecore LMO 2000 mAh 4.20/2.80 V and the titanate-oxide LTO cell of LTOBATTERY Co. 1300 mAh 2.80/1.60 V (positive electrode LiCoO2); carbon negative electrodes except for the LTO cell. 429 cells were aged in synchronized open-circuit storage: 87 each of NCA, NMC, LFP and LCO, 34 LMO and 47 LTO, at three storage temperatures, (18.5 +/- 2.5), (50 +/- 2) and (60 +/- 2) C, and three storage voltages UL, UM and UH per chemistry (Table 2: the 18.5 C cabinet cells at UM only, with 21 of each of the first four chemistries, 4 LMO and 11 LTO; 11 per voltage at 50 and 60 C for NCA, NMC, LFP and LCO, 5 for LMO, 6 for LTO). The storage conditions are voltages, not SOC percentages; the SOC labels recorded here are the repository's. This dataset holds 108 of those cells at 50 and 60 C only. Check-ups use a Neware BTS 4008-5V6A tester, Vötsch/climate chambers and a HIOKI 3554 impedance tester at 20 +/- 2 C: capacity (1C CCCV charge to C/50, 30 min rest, 1C discharge), DC resistance (10 s 1C pulse) and OCV (C/20). The paper says the data are available at THI on request; the Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.6685365 of this dataset is not the 10.5281/zenodo.6546753 that the related modelling paper (Celen et al. 2023), which also names the temperatures 50, 60 and 70 C, cites. The 70 C of that paper is not in this data paper's Table 2. Cell chemistry fix: the six cell types of the paper's Table 1 are NCA, NMC, LFP, LCO and LMO cells with a carbon (graphite) negative electrode and the 1300 mAh LTOBATTERY cell, which pairs a titanate-oxide (LTO) negative electrode with an LCO positive electrode; the file-name prefix 'LTO' had been read as the cathode, so the 18 LTO cells now carry cathode LCO and anode LTO.
